      document.getElementById('work-prev').disabled = workIdx === 0;
      document.getElementById('work-next').disabled = workIdx >= maxIdx;
    }

    document.getElementById('work-prev').addEventListener('click', () => { workIdx = Math.max(0, workIdx - 1); renderWork(); });
    document.getElementById('work-next').addEventListener('click', () => { workIdx = workIdx + 1; renderWork(); });

    let workTouchX = 0;
    workTrack.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { workTouchX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
    workTrack.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - workTouchX;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 40) { workIdx = dx < 0 ? workIdx + 1 : Math.max(0, workIdx - 1); renderWork(); }
    }, { passive: true });

    window.addEventListener('resize', renderWork, { passive: true });
    renderWork();

    /* ── Cookie Banner ── */
    const cookieBanner = document.getElementById('cookie-banner');
    const cookieKey = 'leap_cookie_consent';

    if (!localStorage.getItem(cookieKey)) {
      setTimeout(() => cookieBanner.classList.remove('hidden'), 1200);
    } else {
      cookieBanner.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function dismissCookie(val) {
      localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, val);
      cookieBanner.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s';
      cookieBanner.style.opacity = '0';
      cookieBanner.style.transform = 'translateY(16px)';
      setTimeout(() => cookieBanner.classList.add('hidden'), 300);
    }

    document.getElementById('cookie-accept').addEventListener('click', () => dismissCookie('all'));
    document.getElementById('cookie-decline').addEventListener('click', () => dismissCookie('none'));
    document.getElementById('cookie-manage').addEventListener('click', () => {
      // Show a minimal inline manage state
      cookieBanner.innerHTML = `
        <div>
          <h2 class="cookie-title">Cookie preferences</h2>
          <p class="cookie-body">Choose which cookies you'd like to allow. Essential cookies are always active.</p>
          <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:14px;">
            <label style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);">
              <input type="checkbox" checked disabled style="accent-color:var(--accent);"> Essential (required)
            </label>
            <label style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);">
              <input type="checkbox" id="ck-analytics" checked style="accent-color:var(--accent);"> Analytics
            </label>
            <label style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);">
              <input type="checkbox" id="ck-marketing" style="accent-color:var(--accent);"> Marketing
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="cookie-actions">
          <button class="cookie-btn cookie-accept" id="cookie-save">Save preferences</button>
          <button class="cookie-btn cookie-decline" id="cookie-cancel">Cancel</button>
        </div>`;
      document.getElementById('cookie-save').addEventListener('click', () => dismissCookie('custom'));
      document.getElementById('cookie-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => dismissCookie('none'));
    });

    document.getElementById('cookie-settings-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      localStorage.removeItem(cookieKey);
      location.reload();
    });

    /* ── Scroll animations ── */
    const fadeEls = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    fadeEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

  })();
  </script>

</body>
</html>

        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="footer-bottom">
        <div>
          <div class="footer-logo">Leap<span>.</span></div>
          <p class="footer-tagline">A global creative agency that challenges the status quo to create transformative experiences that win hearts and move markets.</p>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;align-items:flex-end;">
          <div class="footer-links">
            <a href="#team" class="footer-link">Studios</a>
            <a href="#team" class="footer-link">Culture</a>
            <a href="#principles" class="footer-link">DE&I</a>
            <a href="#" class="footer-link">Play</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="footer-legal">
        <span class="footer-copyright">© 2026 Leap Studio, part of Meridian Consulting Group</span>
        <div class="footer-legal-links">
          <a href="#" class="footer-legal-link">Privacy Policy</a>
          <a href="#" class="footer-legal-link">Terms of Use</a>
          <a href="#" class="footer-legal-link">Cookie Policy</a>
          <button class="footer-legal-link" id="cookie-settings-btn" style="background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-b);">Cookie Settings</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <!-- ─── Cookie Banner ──────────────────────────────── -->
  <div class="cookie-banner" id="cookie-banner" role="dialog" aria-label="Cookie consent" aria-live="polite">
    <div>
      <h2 class="cookie-title">We use cookies</h2>
      <p class="cookie-body">We use cookies and similar technologies to personalize content, analyze traffic, and improve your experience. By clicking "Accept All," you consent to our use of cookies.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cookie-actions">
      <button class="cookie-btn cookie-accept" id="cookie-accept">Accept All</button>
      <button class="cookie-btn cookie-manage" id="cookie-manage">Manage Settings</button>
      <button class="cookie-btn cookie-decline" id="cookie-decline">Decline All</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ─── JavaScript ─────────────────────────────────── -->
  <script>
  (() => {
    'use strict';

    /* ── Nav scroll ── */
    const nav = document.getElementById('main-nav');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 20);
    }, { passive: true });

    /* ── Language toggle ── */
    const langBtn = document.getElementById('lang-btn');
    const langDrop = document.getElementById('lang-dropdown');
    langBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = langDrop.classList.toggle('open');
      langBtn.classList.toggle('open', open);
      langBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!langBtn.contains(e.target) && !langDrop.contains(e.target)) {
        langDrop.classList.remove('open');
        langBtn.classList.remove('open');
        langBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      }
    });
    langDrop.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => {
      a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        langDrop.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('active'));
        a.classList.add('active');
        langBtn.querySelector('span').textContent = a.textContent.trim().replace(/^.\s/, '');
        langDrop.classList.remove('open');
        langBtn.classList.remove('open');
        langBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    });

    /* ── Mobile menu ── */
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('nav-hamburger');
    const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('nav-mobile');
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open', open);
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
      document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
    });
    mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => {
      a.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    });

    /* ── Hero Carousel ── */
    let heroIdx = 0;
    const heroSlides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide');
    const heroDots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
    const heroCounter = document.getElementById('hero-counter');
    let heroTimer;

    function goHero(idx) {
      heroSlides[heroIdx].classList.remove('active');
      heroDots[heroIdx].classList.remove('active');
      heroDots[heroIdx].setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      heroIdx = (idx + heroSlides.length) % heroSlides.length;
      heroSlides[heroIdx].classList.add('active');
      heroDots[heroIdx].classList.add('active');
      heroDots[heroIdx].setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      heroCounter.textContent = String(heroIdx + 1).padStart(2,'0') + ' / ' + String(heroSlides.length).padStart(2,'0');
    }

    function startHeroAuto() {
      clearInterval(heroTimer);
      heroTimer = setInterval(() => goHero(heroIdx + 1), 5500);
    }

    document.getElementById('hero-prev').addEventListener('click', () => { goHero(heroIdx - 1); startHeroAuto(); });
    document.getElementById('hero-next').addEventListener('click', () => { goHero(heroIdx + 1); startHeroAuto(); });
    heroDots.forEach((dot, i) => {
      dot.addEventListener('click', () => { goHero(i); startHeroAuto(); });
    });

    // Swipe support
    let heroTouchX = 0;
    document.querySelector('.hero-slides').addEventListener('touchstart', e => { heroTouchX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
    document.querySelector('.hero-slides').addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - heroTouchX;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 50) { goHero(heroIdx + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1)); startHeroAuto(); }
    }, { passive: true });

    startHeroAuto();

    /* ── Team Region Toggle ── */
    const teamTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.team-tab');
    const teamRegions = document.querySelectorAll('.team-region');

    teamTabs.forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const region = tab.dataset.region;
        teamTabs.forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
        teamRegions.forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));
        tab.classList.add('active');
        tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
        document.getElementById('region-' + region).classList.add('active');
        teamCarousels[region] && teamCarousels[region].reset();
      });
    });

    /* ── Team Carousels ── */
    const teamCarousels = {};
    const CARD_W = 340;
    const CARD_GAP = 24;

    function setupTeamCarousel(regionId) {
      const track = document.getElementById('team-track-' + regionId);
      if (!track) return;
      const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.team-card');
      const total = cards.length;
      let idx = 0;

      const progressEl = document.getElementById('team-progress-' + regionId);
      const prevBtn = track.closest('.team-region').querySelector('[data-dir="-1"]');
      const nextBtn = track.closest('.team-region').querySelector('[data-dir="1"]');

      // Build progress dots
      progressEl.innerHTML = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
        const d = document.createElement('div');
        d.className = 'team-prog-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
        progressEl.appendChild(d);
      }

      function render() {
        const trackWrap = track.parentElement;
        const visibleW = trackWrap.offsetWidth;
        const visibleCards = Math.max(1, Math.floor((visibleW + CARD_GAP) / (CARD_W + CARD_GAP)));
        const maxIdx = Math.max(0, total - visibleCards);
        idx = Math.min(idx, maxIdx);
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${idx * (CARD_W + CARD_GAP)}px)`;
        prevBtn.disabled = idx === 0;
        nextBtn.disabled = idx >= maxIdx;
        const dots = progressEl.querySelectorAll('.team-prog-dot');
        dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
      }

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { idx = Math.max(0, idx - 1); render(); });
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { idx = idx + 1; render(); });

      // Touch
      let tx = 0;
      track.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { tx = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
      track.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
        const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - tx;
        if (Math.abs(dx) > 40) { idx = dx < 0 ? idx + 1 : Math.max(0, idx - 1); render(); }
      }, { passive: true });

      teamCarousels[regionId] = { reset() { idx = 0; render(); }, render };
      render();
    }

    ['na', 'asia', 'europe', 'oceania'].forEach(setupTeamCarousel);
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      Object.values(teamCarousels).forEach(c => c.render && c.render());
    }, { passive: true });

    /* ── Work Carousel ── */
    const workTrack = document.getElementById('work-track');
    const workCards = workTrack.querySelectorAll('.work-card');
    const WORK_W = 480;
    const WORK_GAP = 24;
    let workIdx = 0;

    function renderWork() {
      const visibleW = workTrack.parentElement.offsetWidth;
      const visibleCards = Math.max(1, Math.floor((visibleW + WORK_GAP) / (WORK_W + WORK_GAP)));
      const maxIdx = Math.max(0, workCards.length - visibleCards);
      workIdx = Math.min(workIdx, maxIdx);
      workTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${workIdx * (WORK_W + WORK_GAP)}px)`;
      document.getElementById('work-prev').disabled = workIdx === 0;
      document.getElementById('work-next').disabled = workIdx >= maxIdx;
    }

    document.getElementById('work-prev').addEventListener('click', () => { workIdx = Math.max(0, workIdx - 1); renderWork(); });
    document.getElementById('work-next').addEventListener('click', () => { workIdx = workIdx + 1; renderWork(); });

    let workTouchX = 0;
    workTrack.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { workTouchX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
    workTrack.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - workTouchX;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 40) { workIdx = dx < 0 ? workIdx + 1 : Math.max(0, workIdx - 1); renderWork(); }
    }, { passive: true });

    window.addEventListener('resize', renderWork, { passive: true });
    renderWork();

    /* ── Cookie Banner ── */
    const cookieBanner = document.getElementById('cookie-banner');
    const cookieKey = 'leap_cookie_consent';

    if (!localStorage.getItem(cookieKey)) {
      setTimeout(() => cookieBanner.classList.remove('hidden'), 1200);
    } else {
      cookieBanner.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function dismissCookie(val) {
      localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, val);
      cookieBanner.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s';
      cookieBanner.style.opacity = '0';
      cookieBanner.style.transform = 'translateY(16px)';
      setTimeout(() => cookieBanner.classList.add('hidden'), 300);
    }

    document.getElementById('cookie-accept').addEventListener('click', () => dismissCookie('all'));
    document.getElementById('cookie-decline').addEventListener('click', () => dismissCookie('none'));
    document.getElementById('cookie-manage').addEventListener('click', () => {
      // Show a minimal inline manage state
      cookieBanner.innerHTML = `
        <div>
          <h2 class="cookie-title">Cookie preferences</h2>
          <p class="cookie-body">Choose which cookies you'd like to allow. Essential cookies are always active.</p>
          <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:14px;">
            <label style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);">
              <input type="checkbox" checked disabled style="accent-color:var(--accent);"> Essential (required)
            </label>
            <label style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);">
              <input type="checkbox" id="ck-analytics" checked style="accent-color:var(--accent);"> Analytics
            </label>
            <label style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);">
              <input type="checkbox" id="ck-marketing" style="accent-color:var(--accent);"> Marketing
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="cookie-actions">
          <button class="cookie-btn cookie-accept" id="cookie-save">Save preferences</button>
          <button class="cookie-btn cookie-decline" id="cookie-cancel">Cancel</button>
        </div>`;
      document.getElementById('cookie-save').addEventListener('click', () => dismissCookie('custom'));
      document.getElementById('cookie-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => dismissCookie('none'));
    });

    document.getElementById('cookie-settings-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      localStorage.removeItem(cookieKey);
      location.reload();
    });

    /* ── Scroll animations ── */
    const fadeEls = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    fadeEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

  })();
  </script>

</body>
</html>

steps.message:
`/app/output/index.html` is ready — 76KB, HTML validates clean. Here's what was built:

**Design direction:** Luxury/Editorial — near-black `#0A0A0A` base, Syne (display) + Plus Jakarta Sans (body), electric blue accent `#2563EB`, grain texture overlay for depth.

**All 6 interactions implemented:**

1. **Hero carousel** — 5 slides with cinematic gradient backgrounds, auto-advances every 5.5s, prev/next arrows, dot navigation, slide counter, touch/swipe support. Each slide has a unique atmospheric color.

2. **Team region toggle** — 4 tabs (North America, Asia, Europe, Oceania) filter to the correct team members. All 7 people from the brief are placed in their correct regions.

3. **Team member carousel** — per-region track with prev/next arrows, progress dots, touch swipe, responsive card sizing, and `reset()` called on region switch.

4. **Work carousel** — 8 project cards scroll horizontally with arrows + swipe. Cards resize on mobile.

5. **Language dropdown** — toggles open/closed, updates button label on selection, closes on outside click.

6. **Cookie consent banner** — appears after 1.2s delay, persists state in `localStorage`. Accept/Decline dismiss it; Manage Settings reveals inline checkbox preferences. Footer "Cookie Settings" link re-opens it.

**Responsive:** Nav collapses to hamburger + slide-in mobile menu; carousels adapt card width; all grids collapse to single column; font sizes scale down at 768px/480px.
